claim_verdicts.claim_text: The patient has a severe penicillin allergy.

citations.quote: Entry 1 | Allergen: penicillins (reaction occurred with amoxicillin) | Type: allergy | Severity: severe
Entry 1 | Reaction: anaphylaxis (generalized hives, throat tightness, hypotension) | Onset: 2019-05 | Treated in an emergency department with intramuscular epinephrine
Allergies reviewed with patient: in May 2019 amoxicillin caused hives, throat swelling and low blood pressure that required epinephrine in the emergency department.

claim_verdicts.why: The allergy list records penicillins as a severe allergy with the reaction occurring with amoxicillin, and the 2024 clinic note describes the same May 2019 reaction treated with epinephrine. The entry is active and was reviewed in 2024.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The patient had anaphylaxis after amoxicillin in May 2019.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: No allergy testing has been performed.

citations.quote: Patient reports avoiding all penicillins since then; no allergy testing or supervised challenge has been performed.

claim_verdicts.why: The 2024 clinic note states directly that no allergy testing or supervised challenge has been performed, which matches the claim. The claim is stated as an absence within that document and is not contradicted by any shown line.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The record shows only the 2024-08-12 clinic note's statement; it does not confirm that no testing has occurred at any time since then, and the ED note of 2026-02-14 says nothing about testing.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: No other drug allergies are documented.

citations.quote: No other allergies or intolerances are recorded.

claim_verdicts.why: The allergy list states no other allergies or intolerances are recorded, which directly supports the claim that no other drug allergies are documented.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The ED triage note lists NKDA, which is consistent with this claim; the record does not show any other allergy entries. The claim is about documentation only, not the patient's true allergy status.
